title: Tree trimming near power lines
lines: Trees near power lines are one of the most dangerous jobs.
We don't go near the line without coordinating with the electric company first.
We keep our distance, with the basket and with the tools.
A licensed trimmer, an experienced operator and proper planning, and it all goes smoothly.
Send a photo of the tree, and we'll tell you if it can be done.
disclaimer: This video is not official training|and does not replace training and hands-on practice|and is not a work-at-height permit|a reminder only
